title: Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer leaves Google for OpenAI; DeepMind talent exodus follows
summary: Transformer co-author Noam Shazeer joined OpenAI, followed by Nobel laureate John Jumper (Jun 20) and two more DeepMind researchers moving to Anthropic (Jun 24); Alphabet shares fell sharply.
reason: Top talent consolidating at two leading labs; modest concentration effect.

title: China reportedly unveils 2 trillion yuan five-year AI infrastructure plan
summary: Reports said Beijing announced a roughly $295B five-year plan for national AI data centers requiring at least 80% domestic technology.
reason: State-directed mega compute plan; single secondary source, so low credibility - verify before relying.

title: Northwestern prints artificial neurons that signal with living brain tissue
summary: Researchers reported two-way communication between printed organic-polymer neurons and biological neural tissue.
